title: Stream Write
text: Stream data from processor algorithms to shared memory, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Device name} sets the name of IP core, {Number of buffers} sets the number of data buffers and {Enable event-based execution} sets the option to enable event-driven task. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data frame from software algorithm vector

ports.name: done
ports.summary: Notification of available buffer in memory scalar

ports.name: status
ports.summary: Status of completed write transaction scalar

params.name: Device name
params.values: Name of IP core device ip:MM2S (default) | colon-separated list of IP core name and channel

params.name: Number of buffers
params.values: Number of data buffers 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable event-based execution
params.values: Option to enable event-driven task execution on (default) | off
